What I will do right now: book your next Dr. Chen slot at Gwinnett Community Clinic, ask her to write the imaging-coverage letter she offered last month, and confirm sliding-scale pricing so the specialist workup lands closer to $20-60, not $400. If you want, I can also pull a list of Gwinnett clinics that take your ACA plan for a second opinion on cost.
